name: Yuganda Akai Ito
source:
Hero is a ronin student preparing for university entrance exams. One day he sees his sister Sanae taking shower and begins to think of her as a woman. Then adult woman entered his life as tutor. Where will desires bring the hero?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名准备大学入学考试的复读生。某天他看到妹妹早苗在洗澡，开始将她视为女人。随后一位成年女性以家庭教师的身份进入了他的生活。欲望将把主人公引向何方？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
